items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: Benny Goodman became King of Swing, went into that, went out with the battle of bands

ctx.x: Was black in at that time?

Yeah. Well, that's why I said it was particularly for the blacks. See, the blacks wasn't as plentiful as the whites. But I mean, just to be appearing in an interracial show, like -- (recording interruption) So it was particularly an advantage and a great improvement for the blacks because they began to work also in the theaters from nightclubs, and then it went on up to around in the early -- till the battle of bands, and Benny Goodman became King of Swing, went into that, went out with the battle of bands, but…
But you were performing primarily in New York City at that time.
